epoch_rule: ceil(median of 18 selected development best epochs per architecture); last fixed epoch retained
training_rule: full mature expanding history at each original semiannual cutoff; no test-origin samples
selection_rule: mean MAE/persistence MAE, equal development block x horizon x seed weights; selected before calibration/test
calibration_boundary_rule: strict availability before deadline for all three labels; exclude boundary origin from all interval fits only
interval_rule: per model/seed/horizon pooled prequential calibration absolute errors; ceil((n+1)*0.8) order statistic; symmetric, untrimmed, no exact coverage guarantee
test_rule: one frozen-policy online evaluation; no hyperparameter, seed, epoch, network or quantile selection from test
deployment_rule: last scheduled test refit checkpoint of development-selected network, operational seed42; expose model age; no extra post-test fit
